summary: Security remediation validated end-to-end. Backend security suite (tests/test_security.py) 18/18 PASS: SEC-001 JWT rotation (strong secret, valid/no/forged/expired token handling), SEC-002 dev endpoint gated by APP_ENV=development, SEC-003 AI quota (Free 20/mo → 429 cloud_quota_exceeded, Pro unlimited, oversized prompt 413, /ai/usage server truth), P3 (password<8 → 400, generic 'Invalid email or password', login throttle 429, voice unauth 401 + unsupported ext 415, VIN regex ReDoS-safe). Frontend regression checked on mobile viewport (390x844): (1) Stale/invalid jarvis_token cleanly falls back to auth screen — no crash/white screen. (2) Fresh register and login both reach the tabs (Command / Live / JARVIS / Health / Garage). (3) With db.ai_usage seeded to 20 for the logged-in Free user, next JARVIS Cloud chat renders the graceful assistant message: 'You've reached the Free plan limit of 20 JARVIS Cloud AI requests this month. Upgrade to Pro...' — not a crash/blank. (4) Switching AI Engine to LOCAL_AI or OPENAI_USER_KEY in /ai-settings persists across reload and does NOT call /api/chat or /api/ai/analyze (verified via request tracking) — quota is not consumed. FOUND ONE FRONTEND↔BACKEND CONTRACT BUG (independent of security work but surfaced during testing): assistant.tsx passes `vehicle: platformSummary` (a string) to /api/chat, but ChatInput.vehicle is Optional[dict] → 422 dict_type whenever vehicle identity is loaded. First chat attempt showed '⚠️ Request failed' instead of the quota message for exactly this reason; only worked once identity was empty. Fix: either change backend to Optional[Any] (like DtcAnalyzeInput.vehicle) or wrap platformSummary in a dict on the frontend.

ui_bugs.issue: Sends `vehicle: platformSummary` (string returned by buildVehicleIntelligence(identity).platformSummary) to POST /api/chat, but backend ChatInput.vehicle is Optional[dict] → 422 dict_type. When any vehicle identity is loaded (typical after telemetry populates), every Cloud chat fails with '⚠️ Request failed', masking legitimate quota-429 messages and breaking core flow for Free users. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/assistant.tsx:94 (`vehicle: platformSummary`) and /app/backend/server.py:96 (ChatInput.vehicle: Optional[dict]).

integration_issues.issue: Payload type mismatch on `vehicle` (string vs dict) yields intermittent 422 depending on whether telemetry identity has populated. Reproduced via curl: string='2020 Jeep Wrangler' → 422; dict={'make':'Jeep'} → 200; null → 200.

action_items: Fix /api/chat vehicle payload contract: either loosen backend `ChatInput.vehicle` to `Optional[Any]` (matches DtcAnalyzeInput.vehicle) OR change assistant.tsx to send a structured dict (e.g. `vehicle: identity ? { make, model, year, trim, engine, vin } : undefined`) instead of the string platformSummary. Recommend backend change for minimal risk since other AI endpoints already use Optional[Any].
Optional: after fix, re-run the quota-429 UI test to confirm the graceful message surfaces reliably even when a vehicle identity is present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1500 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, vehicles, ai, subscription, diagnostics) for maintainability. Not blocking.
In-memory _rate_buckets/_login_buckets are per-process only; behind a multi-worker deployment throttling will be weaker than expected. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting for prod.
ChatInput.vehicle uses Optional[dict] while DtcAnalyzeInput.vehicle and AIAnalyzeInput.vehicle use Optional[Any] — inconsistency caused the 422 bug above.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (stale-token, register/login, quota-429 graceful, provider switch persist + no-quota-consumption all pass; JARVIS Cloud chat has a 422 regression when vehicle identity is populated)

seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral test users via /api/auth/register with password 'Jarvis2026!' and seeded db.ai_usage {user_id, month:'YYYY-MM', requests_used:20, provider:'cloud'} to trigger the Free quota 429 without spending real LLM calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend security tests are stable — re-run tests/test_security.py after any auth/quota changes. For the quota-429 UI test use the seed pattern in /tmp/seed_and_get.py (register → set requests_used=20 for current month → login via UI → send chat). Vehicle testID enum values in ai-settings are uppercase: ai-option-JARVIS_CLOUD, ai-option-OPENAI_USER_KEY, ai-option-LOCAL_AI.
rca_of_issue: Assistant chat 422: platformSummary from buildVehicleIntelligence is a formatted string (e.g. '2020 Jeep Wrangler Sahara 3.6L V6'), but /api/chat's Pydantic model declares `vehicle: Optional[dict]`. Reproduction: POST /api/chat {vehicle: '2020 Jeep Wrangler', message:'hi', session_id:'s'} → 422 dict_type. Mitigation options: (A) backend one-line fix — change ChatInput.vehicle to Optional[Any] (consistent with sibling AI models). (B) frontend fix — send `vehicle: identity ? { year, make, model, trim, engine, vin } : undefined` in assistant.tsx. Recommend (A).
